title: gambitR3D tensor worker protocol 1.0
description: Newline-delimited JSON over the worker's stdin (requests) and stdout (replies). One JSON object per line, at most 8 MiB per line (UTF-8 bytes, newline excluded). Logs go to stderr and are never parsed. Non-finite numbers (NaN, Infinity) are invalid JSON and are rejected in both directions. The worker never implements game rules and never returns a board state: R sends encoded positions (schema g3-features/1) with their canonical legal candidates and validates every reply. One request is in flight at a time; cancel and shutdown may arrive while a request runs and are honoured between training steps.

protocol_version.description: Major version 1; any other major version is refused before work starts.

request_id.description: Unique per request; null only on heartbeats and on errors about a line that could not be parsed.

state_hash.description: Full-state checksum of the position, when one position is concerned.

rules_hash.description: Rules-profile hash; fixed for the session at hello and checked on every later request and checkpoint.

feature_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of schemas/features-v1.json, computed independently by R and the worker.

action_schema_hash.description: SHA-256 of the action schema id 'g3-action/1'.

model_hash.description: Weights digest the client expects to be loaded (infer_batch, train_chunk, save_checkpoint).

deadline.description: Unix time in seconds; an expired deadline is refused, a deadline reached during training stops it cleanly.

echo: Every reply to a request (accepted, progress, result, error, cancelled) repeats request_id, job_id, attempt_id, operation, state_hash, rules_hash, feature_schema_hash, action_schema_hash, model_hash, budget and deadline exactly. R stops a worker whose reply does not echo them; replies for unknown or already finished requests are rejected and counted (stale, duplicate).

liveness.rules: The worker sends a heartbeat every 2 s. A client that hears nothing for the stale threshold kills the worker. A cancel that is not acknowledged by a terminal reply within the grace period ends in killing the process tree.

positions.candidate_digest: SHA-256 of candidate_ids joined by a newline

outputs.wdl_logits: [3] number (win, draw, loss; side to act)

infer_batch.client_checks: R re-checks the digest, the number of logits, finiteness, forms probabilities over the complete legal set itself and maps them to action ids. Padding is internal to the worker.

train_chunk.cancelled: Same payload with stop_reason cancelled and the steps completed so far.

save_checkpoint.atomicity: Files are written into a temporary sibling directory, flushed with fsync, hashed, and the directory is renamed into place; R then re-hashes them and writes model.json last.

load_checkpoint.safety: Only safetensors and JSON are read; hashes are verified on the bytes before deserialisation; no pickle loader is ever called; only the AdamW optimizer structure is reconstructed.

result.reason: not_active when nothing matching was running

request.kind: malformed_line | crash | nonfinite | wrong_echo | duplicate_result | stale_response | hang

debug_fault.availability: Refused unless the worker was started with --enable-fault-injection (tests only).
